results.note: The test asserts that the catalog-v2 call is request #1. It then checks that history start_time equals the later of the two per-metric min_times (FlowOut 2020-02-01) and that both min_times are recorded in source_field. The implementation is _catalog_metric_min_times and backfill_coinmetrics_asset_metrics in ingest/fetchers/coinmetrics.py.

An empty response inside the catalog window returns (). The test at line 233 shows that a start_time before min_time raises ValueError before any history request is made, so the two cases are handled differently. That second test calls the private _history_rows directly, because the public recipe always starts at min_time.

The test runs 12 requests (1 catalog, 11 paginated pages) on a fake clock. It asserts that every group of 10 consecutive requests spans at least 6s, so the community-tier rate limit is enforced rather than assumed away. No 429 retry path is tested.

The test asserts that the second request URL exactly equals the vendor's next_page_url. It also checks that rows from both pages come back in order, as [1.0, 2.0] with matching timestamps, and that paging stops when next_page_url is absent.

Attempt 2 fixed the test's shape. It now drives the public run_backfill entry point (ingest/backfill.py:67) against live Coin Metrics and real Postgres, and asserts that the persisted row's source_timestamp equals the catalog min_time with origin 'backfill'. However, it is @pytest.mark.integration, and pyproject.toml:33 (addopts '-m not integration') deselects it: the gates report '380 passed, 74 deselected'. The only files under 50-evidence/US-905 are gates.json, verdict.json and diffstat.txt, and none of them records a live run. There is no proof this test has ever passed against real data.
The `uv run pytest -q` gate exited 0: 380 passed, 74 deselected. mypy --strict is also clean.

note: The offline tests for C1–C4 make real assertions against MockTransport and are not faked. C5 is still not met: the live integration test now correctly goes through run_backfill with persistence, but the gate's marker filter deselects it and no evidence of a live run exists.
